testcase.name: no action caption ever claims a pass()
every action carries an idempotency key and the revision it was decided against()
revoke and reject are destructive, everything else is not()
a rejection shows its reason inline()
the revoke consequence prefers DIAL's own sentence and otherwise says what it does not know()
409 is STALE_VIEW carrying the new revision, and its retry is a new decision()
a steer needs guidance and a decision needs approve or reject()
the projection's actions list parses and ignores rows without an id()
only the projection moves an accepted action, and only for its own id()
a settled action is not moved again by a later projection()
no revision on screen means no action, which is also why nothing is queued offline()
202 is ACCEPTED and pending, never done, even if the forwarder says APPLIED()
an unconfirmed send retries with the same key so DIAL cannot apply it twice()
